dependencies.name: scoringutils
dependencies.summary: Scores forecasts. hubEvals and hubPredEvalsData score predictions with it.

dependencies.name: arrow (R)
dependencies.summary: Reads and queries Parquet and CSV datasets. hubData and hubValidations read model output and target data with it.

dependencies.name: pyarrow
dependencies.summary: Python library for Arrow and Parquet. hub-data and hubverse-transform read and write hub data with it.

dependencies.name: jsonvalidate
dependencies.summary: Validates JSON against a JSON schema. hubAdmin, hubValidations and hubPredEvalsData validate configuration files with it.

dependencies.name: distfromq
dependencies.summary: Reconstructs a distribution from a set of quantiles. hubEnsembles uses it for linear pool ensembles of quantile forecasts.

dependencies.name: zoltr
dependencies.summary: R client for the Zoltar forecast repository. hubData uses it to collect forecasts from Zoltar.

dependencies.name: predtimechart
dependencies.summary: JavaScript forecast visualisation component. hub-dashboard-predtimechart builds the dashboard forecast view on it.

dependents.name: modelimportance
dependents.title: Measuring Contributions of Component Models to Ensemble Forecast Accuracy
